description: Shared corpus for the blueprint definition of done. The TypeScript engine (verifyBlueprintPackage, describeBlueprintCatalog, evaluateBlueprintPin, compareVersions) and the C# engine (BlueprintVerification, BlueprintCatalog, BlueprintVersionPin, PackageVersionRange) must report the same problems, entries and pin evaluations. Verification problems are compared in order.
